svg.aria-label: A request, event, schedule or ticket starts a workflow, which schedules each run on a durable execution layer, CI/CD or a step runner, that starts the same agent harness in a fresh sandbox behind its own proxy. The pull request goes through approval to merge, review feedback drives the next run, and the authorization service, supply chain firewall, model gateway and downstream are the same as at Level 1.

g.text: the coding agent, configured by its profile
all four boundaries’ records, linked by run
